The '''Vulpter system''' was a six-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and contained the planet of [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]].<ref name="Core" />
